summary: The bad() entry point reads a Kerberos password over a plaintext TCP Socket, transmitting sensitive authentication material in cleartext (CWE-319). The fix replaces the plain java.net.Socket with a TLS-encrypted SSLSocket created via SSLSocketFactory, so the same host/port connection and line-reading feature still works but the data is now transmitted over an encrypted channel. No behavior is disabled and valid inputs continue to flow through.
